transcript.text: Alright, let's get started. This is our final-lock meeting for Night Signal before the public opening on Friday. I'd like to hear from each of you in turn — technical, accessibility, and labor leads, please give me your standard operating reports. Once I've heard and recorded everyone's requirements, I'll make my final call on the public-opening package.
